acceptance_before_effects: every architecture beats the naive forecaster on validation at h = 3, r = 1 (receiver adequacy), else its effects are reported as NOT_INTERPRETABLE
cost pilots complete without test access

A.detector: 2 residual causal Conv1D blocks (16 filters, kernel 3, dilation 1)
A.name: Conv1D local (reference)

C.integrator: GRU(16, return_sequences) — GRU chosen over LSTM BEFORE any result: fewer parameters at equal width and one state
C.name: Conv1D + GRU

budget.hosts: three healthy roles under their own identities; memory-aware concurrency per host
budget.scope: RP9-RP16: ML tests, re-verification inference, instrumentation, pilots, failures and this comparison; the executed pilot's history is separate

common.activation_note: ELU is a DEV decision recorded after the ML07 diagnostic of arch B; it is applied to every architecture as a common factor, not as a transferred result
common.core: Conv1D(16,3,causal,ELU) for sequence fusions; Dense(32,ELU) for summary fusions
common.head: Dense(p) + persistence skip
common.parameters_differ: widths are common; parameter counts differ by architecture and are recorded per cell; equal counts would not prove functional equivalence and are not imposed
common.reach_note: declared and tested by perturbation (tests/test_df_mod_e0_arch.py); the core sees 3 positions, so ARCH-0 and ARCH-A reach the planted lag tau = 3 (ARCH-0: x[t-2] = a[t+1-tau]) — they do not lose for a blind core; the period 24 is beyond their reach by construction (that is what the comparison measures)

diagnostic.why: absent from the executed pilot: a deterministic drift and two level shifts (one in train, one in test) test receiver adequacy and the corrected trend descriptor; no effect is estimated on it

donor_sensitivity.why: bounded: is the H3 contrast sensitive to a donor optimised for the summary receiver? Shared within each pair; the sequence-trained donor is NOT called neutral

estimands.ARCH: differences of the above effects and of raw MASE / cost between architectures, descriptive; no winner presupposed
estimands.DONOR: delta_a = d_a,1(donor summary) - d_a,1(donor sequence) on the bounded subset
estimands.DX: MASE of the profiles arm vs naive / linear / oracle under trend_event per architecture: adequacy, no effect
estimands.H2_within_arch: e_a(h) = MASE(profiles) - mean MASE(random) per replicate, slope over h, per architecture a
estimands.H3_within_arch: d_a,r = MASE(sequence-fusion arms) - MASE(summary-fusion arms) per replicate, averaged over readouts; gamma_a = d_1 - d_0
estimands.READOUT: rho_a,r = MASE(last readouts) - MASE(pooled readouts) per replicate, averaged over fusions: separates the readout from preserving history until fusion (the 2 x 2 fusion x readout within each (arch, r, replicate) shares one donor)

fusions.sequence: channel concatenation of the aligned sequences -> Conv1D(16,3,causal) core -> LAST position -> Dense(p)
fusions.sequence_gap: channel concatenation -> Conv1D(16,3,causal) core -> global average over time -> Dense(p) (readout control: same fusion, pooled readout)
fusions.summary: global average per branch -> concatenation -> Dense(32) core -> Dense(p)
fusions.summary_last: LAST position per branch -> concatenation -> Dense(32) core -> Dense(p) (readout control: same summary fusion, last-step readout)

review_table.obligation: generator reproduces equations, population and distribution; labels/metadata/latent group never features
future/validation/test changes leave fit, groups and past outputs unchanged; roles by identity/time
H2 changes the assignment, not names; sizes, models, contexts, budget equal per arm
H3 preserves marginals in distribution and changes the relevant dependence; no shuffle control
H3 arms use identical frozen extractor activations; freezing verified by weights
group -> detector/integrator/adapter -> fusion -> core/head keeps temporal shape; real gradients
positive learning with the real receiver; oracle and naive references; curves distinguish lack of training from lack of utility
early stopping by validation, real weight restore, reload parity, test never selects
metrics from arrays; shared denominators; zero policy; empty/non-finite refuse
e(h), d0/d1/gamma with the declared sign; replicates/seeds/windows never inflate the unit
child reads delivered bytes; CPU updates observed; complete costs and limits
a real failure leaves a terminal/outbox; reconciliation by population and content

successor_reason: DX_RERUN_AFTER_CODE_DEFECT: the four DX cells of the stage failed at start (KeyError 'profiles' in run_cell: the diagnostic hypothesis was routed to the H3 arm map; recorded as UNCERTAIN terminals with their tracebacks); fixed at commit deec2ca9d495eaabf7278cf815124bae574c19e8 (DX uses the H2 arms); this successor re-runs the four diagnostic cells only, inheriting the stage's measured pilot costs

training.ml07_diagnostic: plain ReLU stack + mae + lr 1e-3 + 3000 updates stayed at the naive level (val MASE 0.49 vs naive 0.50, linear 48x8 reference 0.43); residual TCN blocks with ELU + mse + lr 3e-3 + 6000 updates + patience 30 reach 0.43-0.46 on 3/3 seeds (relu at lr 1e-2 collapsed on 3/3); metrics reported are MAE/MASE, the optimisation loss is mse
training.stage_note: DX-only successor of the informative stage; same allowance, patience and geometry
training.tuning_allowance: NONE after the ML07 instrument diagnostic (sealed before any pilot cell)
